statement: B200 enterprise lead times improved to 8-16 weeks from 12-24 weeks in Q4 2025 for OEM buyers.
why: Shorter delivery times indicate easing merchant-GPU supply as OEM allocation improves.

impact.mechanism: Falling lead times signal loosening merchant-GPU supply as packaging allocation catches up to orders.

evidence.excerpt: enterprise buyers with OEM relationships 8-16 weeks delivery (improved from 12-24 weeks in Q4 2025)

confidence.basis: Single secondary availability report citing broker data.
